title: BGP Export Policy Removed — dc2-spine1 stops advertising underlay routes
symptom: DC2 leaf nodes stop receiving underlay prefixes from dc2-spine1. BGP sessions stay up but inet.0 routes from spine1 disappear from leaf routing tables.
root_cause: export policy removed from protocols bgp group LEAF-UNDERLAY on dc2-spine1
fix_command: set protocols bgp group LEAF-UNDERLAY export EXPORT-ALL
